items.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: premium Korean fantasy RPG inventory item icon, standalone transparent-background raster asset. Generate ONE finished item, a refined magical enhancement parchment scroll, not a UI card and not a sheet of variants. Square canvas, generous clear transparent margin at least 12% on every side, entire scroll and fittings inside the canvas. An opened ivory vellum scroll with gently rolled top and bottom edges, restrained champagne gold and platinum end fittings, exquisite clean illustrated metal materials. Readable bold central emblem at 64px. Three-quarter shallow perspective with a slight diagonal tilt, elegant polished 2D painted game illustration with precise clean silhouette, controlled luminous highlights. No purple, no grunge, no busy tiny inscriptions, no numbers, no lettering, no words, no logo, no watermark, no frame, no floor shadow, no background. Actual alpha transparency outside the item. Avoid a wide blank title plaque. Preserve a premium clear silhouette and visible vellum. Primary request: WEAPON ENHANCEMENT SCROLL. Deep crimson red velvet edging and small ruby clasps, warm gold glow. Center is a large striking metallic gold SWORD sigil embossed on the parchment, a single straight long blade with a very clear pointed tip and simple crossguard, ruby inset at its hilt. Blade, guard center, grip and pommel form one continuous straight rigid axis. The sword emblem is the focal point, with sparse rising gold energy flecks close to its edges. This must instantly read as a weapon strengthening scroll, distinct from a shield protection ticket.
